title: slugify with accent folding and a word-boundary length cap
requirements: slugify(text) lowercases, joins words with single hyphens, drops punctuation and trims leading/trailing hyphens
Accented Latin letters are transliterated to plain ASCII ('Café Ñandú' -> 'cafe-nandu')
max_len cuts at a word boundary and never leaves a trailing hyphen
user_messages: need a slugify() in slugkit for blog post titles. lowercase, words joined with single dashes, no punctuation, no dashes at the start or end
and accents need to turn into plain letters, 'Café Ñandú' should come out cafe-nandu not caf-and
also a max_len option, cut at a word boundary, never leave a dash dangling at the end
